comments.comment: For what it's worth: I watched the first episode in real time, I was 14 years old, and I loved it. From the start. Conan was awkward, Andy was awkward, Max was awkward, the show was clumsy, stuff fell flat. Honest to God I didn't care in the least. For some reason these guys were just the most interesting, compelling thing to watch. And it was happening just as Letterman had moved to CBS & was pretty much doing the smoothest, funniest stuff of his career. So to watch that highly polished machine run at 11:30 on CBS, then switch over to NBC at 12:30 & watch something that was more akin to public access than network television...I don't know, it was just such a great time for comedy on TV. Nothing like that ever happened before, nothing like that's happened since, nothing like that will ever happen again. Glad I got to experience it. #TeamCoco4Life
